gameLoop: Survive the monster arena: kite enemy packs, snipe them with auto-aimed bolts, slash close attackers with a spin attack, grab hearts and loot, clear all 5 waves.

enemies.role: tanky chaser that walks the player down
fast weaver that strafes while closing in
ranged shooter that holds range and fires bolts

progression: Five waves with growing counts and speed; short breather between waves.
scoring: 100+ per kill scaled by enemy tier, 250 bonus per cleared wave.
notes: Demo blueprint for the battle-2d template.
